notes:
## Design Aesthetic and Shape
- The remote control should have a modern look with rounded corners, avoiding the appearance of old square remotes or fully curved iPod-style devices.
- The shape will be mostly square with rounded corners, not fully curved in depth.
- The design should look new and original, avoiding the look of old square remotes or the iPod style.
## Materials and Power
- The case will be made of hard plastic, not rubber or soft materials.
- The remote control will use rechargeable batteries as the energy source.
## Chip and Display
- The remote control will use the regular (second most expensive) chip.
- The team decided to include speech recognition and an advanced chip.
## Interface Layout
- The numbers will be located at the bottom of the remote.
- The channel switch buttons will be located in the middle of the remote.
- The volume control will be a scroll wheel on the side of the remote.
- The scroll wheel will be small and yellow to match the 'Real Reaction' colors.
tldr: The team finalized the design specifications for a modern remote control, settling on a mostly square shape with rounded corners, hard plastic construction, and a small yellow scroll wheel. They decided to include speech recognition and an advanced chip, though they initially debated the cost and complexity of these features.
